items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: for the bebop, there's K. Wenge and there's J.J. Johnson, there's two best. I mean of the old times, your whole life, it's the best you ever heard.

ctx.x: I was going to ask you, I don't want to put you on the spot, but I mean if you don't mind saying who would be your favorite trombone player. There's nothing wrong with having a favorite, I mean that's not insulting the other people, because I know you like a lot of them, you told me you liked a whole bunch of them. Well if you had to pick one or two.

Well if I had to pick a trombone player, these modern day trombone players, I'd have to pick them from the style. Now for that bebop, I like some of it, some of it I don't. But for the bebop, there's K. Wenge and there's J.J. Johnson, there's two best. I mean of the old times, your whole life, it's the best you ever heard.
